Book correction: The book stops at |f(2.6125)| = 0.0068 \approx 0.01, but the 8.3.1 rule for 2 decimal places is |f(c)| < 0.005. One more iteration: c = \frac{(2.6125)(8) - (3)(-0.0068)}{8 - (-0.0068)} = 2.6128, f(2.6128) = -0.0015, and 0.0015 < 0.005. The final root x \approx 2.61 is unchanged.
